spans.s:
mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Well-secured, having a good binding.
m. (-न्धः)
Sesamum.
E.
सु, and बन्ध binding.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Wise, clever, intelligent.
E.
सु, and बुद्धि intellect.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Easily taught.
2 Of easy apprehension.
m. (-धः)
1

Waking.
E.
सु, and बोध making known.

m. (-ण्यः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
सु good, and ब्रह्मण्य the Brahmanical order, of whom he is the special guardian.
